hooks.command: if [ -z "$COWORK_MAIL_AUTORUN_DISABLED" ]; then python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/debug_log.py" SessionStart && python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/session_start.py" && python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/autorun_once.py" --workspace-dir "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" --reason SessionStart; fi

if [ -z "$COWORK_MAIL_AUTORUN_DISABLED" ]; then python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/debug_log.py" Stop && python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/check_marker.py" && python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/autorun_once.py" --workspace-dir "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" --reason Stop; fi
